$comment: FRANK-§17.2: 'Domain modules do not import provider SDKs. Adapters implement contracts declared in packages/contracts.' This file is the mechanical definition of 'provider SDK'. Adding a name here makes it a CI failure inside the denied layers; it does not restrict adapters, which exist precisely to hold provider coupling. FRANK-§0.2: a third-party package may not become a core dependency merely because an agent can install it — widening the allowed layers below requires an ADR.
